title: SmartThings Schema Event Attribute Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=smartthings:schema attribute_value=*
| stats sum(attribute_value) as total_value, avg(attribute_value) as avg_value by device_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks device values by total and average attribute value across SmartThings schema event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `attribute_value` values for each SmartThings schema event event and review total and average attribute value by device.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total attribute value.
grandmaExplanation: It will rank which device shows the biggest attribute value numbers in your SmartThings schema event data.
